arts_boxoffice.text: Tickets? Sit anywhere. The seats are comfy and the plays have so far been free of seagulls.
The National Eisteddfod is a week-long festival of Welsh music, poetry and dance. The word means a sitting. It moves between North and South Wales each year.
The modern festival began in 1861, though bards have been competing for centuries. A good poem here can win you a chair. A real one.

arts_singer.text: Cân is song. And hwyl is the feeling that takes over when a whole hall sings together. Hear it once and you will know.
